name: progress-bar
purpose: Determinate or indeterminate progress indicator (role="progressbar") with a visible label, localized percentage value text, optional help text, and tones that never rely on color alone.
whenToUse: Operations with measurable progress (uploads, imports, multi-step processing).
Long operations of unknown duration where a labelled indeterminate bar is clearer than a spinner.
whenNotToUse: Short waits under about a second: use nothing, or a delayed Spinner.
Showing a static quantity or capacity (disk usage, scores): use a meter.
Placeholder layout while content loads: use Skeleton.
responsive: Fills the inline size of its container; the label wraps and the value text stays on one line at the inline end.
rtl: Logical properties: the fill grows from the inline start, the indeterminate sweep runs toward the inline end, and the value sits at the inline end.
theme: Track uses color-surface-sunken with a color-border-strong boundary; fill uses color-primary or the tone foreground token. Forced-colors mode uses Highlight and CanvasText.
security: Label, description, and value text are rendered with textContent. The fill width is written as the --aui-progress custom property through the CSSOM (CSP-safe).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: One bar per operation; tested with frequent setValue() calls (every animation frame).

limitations: Completion is announced once per transition to max; values that stay at max do not re-announce. A bar created at max does not announce.
unsupported: Rendering HTML in the label or value text.
antiPatterns: Announcing every value change through a live region.
Communicating success or failure by color alone (use the tone option, which adds a labelled icon).
Using a progress bar for a static measurement.
